title: Presence by month (full year)
description: Same presence definition as the heatmap: topic home/esp13/sensors/presence, payload='1', sum(arrow_cast(payload Utf8→Int32)) grouped by calendar month; only {{YEAR}} in the URL (not {{MONTH}}).

data.url: http://fhome.frett27.internal:3000/sql/select month, sum(arrow_cast(arrow_cast(payload,'Utf8'),'Int32')) as avg_v from mqtt_hive where topic='home%2Fesp13%2Fsensors%2Fpresence' and year={{YEAR}} and payload='1' group by month order by month
